# Contributing to RPCS3 for Xbox

This is an unofficial, proof-of-concept port of RPCS3 to Xbox (UWP, Developer Mode). Please don't
ask the RPCS3 team for help with it.

- **Compatibility reports** are very welcome: open an issue with the "Game compatibility report"
  template (game, title ID, app version, how far it gets, and the log if you can).
- **Bugs**: use the "Bug report" template and attach `LocalState/rpcs3/RPCS3.log`.
- **Pull requests** are welcome too. Building and how the port works are described in
  [uwp/README.md](../uwp/README.md). Keep changes for the Xbox port behind the UWP build where they
  would change desktop RPCS3, and say in the PR whether you tested it on a console.

Emulator fixes that are not Xbox-specific are better sent to [RPCS3](https://github.com/RPCS3/rpcs3)
itself, so everyone benefits.
